Pockett Quran Privacy Policy

Effective: 19 September 2026

Pockett Quran is an educational application designed to help readers explore Quranic text, translations, themes, events and related study material.

Information collection

Pockett Quran does not require an account and does not collect, transmit, sell or share personal information. The application does not use advertising identifiers, analytics trackers or third-party advertising.

Information stored on your device

Reading preferences and application settings may be stored locally on your device so the application can remember them. This information remains on your device and can be removed by clearing the application data or uninstalling the application.

Quran and translation data

The application includes Quranic text and translations from attributed sources. These reference files are application content and contain no personal information.

Children’s privacy

Because the application does not collect personal information, it does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes

If the application’s data practices change, this policy will be updated before the relevant application update is released.

Contact and support

Questions about this policy may be submitted through the Pockett Quran support page.
